description: This file defines a Java Servlet class 'RemoveCartProducts' that handles POST requests to remove items from the shopping cart based on product ID, managing HTTP sessions and redirecting to view the updated cart.

classes.name: RemoveCartProducts
classes.description: Servlet for removing products from shopping cart based on product ID.
